articles.summary: Mercantile Bank Corporation (NASDAQ: MBWM) ("Mercantile") announced today that each of the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (the "FDIC") and Michigan Department of Insurance and Financial Services ("DIFS") has approved Mercantile Bank's application to merge Eastern Michigan Bank with and into Mercantile Bank and to establish the twelve offices of Eastern Michigan Bank as branches of the resulting bank. The FDIC granted its approval on November 4, 2026, subject to the conditions in its approval letter and order, including that all other required regulatory approvals be obtained before the bank merger is completed. DIFS granted its approval on November 13, 2026. With receipt of these approvals, and, as previously announced, Mercantile expects to complete the bank merger in the first quarter of 2027. Under the terms of the FDIC's approval, the bank merger must be completed by May 4, 2027, unless the FDIC extends that deadline. The FDIC may modify, suspend or withdraw its approval at
articles.title: Mercantile Bank Corporation Announces FDIC and Michigan DIFS Approval of Merger of Mercantile Bank and Eastern Michigan Bank
